ai_summary.text:
Sansanは名刺管理サービスや請求書管理のBill Oneを展開する法人向けSaaS企業で、売上高432億円と前年比約30%の高成長を達成した。営業利益28億円と黒字化を果たしたが、純利益は4億円と営業外費用の負担が重い。自己資本比率は約30%で成長企業としては標準的。営業CF97億円と極めて強い現金創出力を持ちFCF71億円のプラス。スコア78点はSaaS事業の高成長と安定したCFを評価。

1株当たり利益（EPS）は3.4円、1株当たり純資産（BPS）は118.3円、自己資本利益率（ROE）は2.6%の水準にある。事業収益の安定化と経営効率の向上を通じた内部留保の蓄積で将来の成長に向けた投資余力を確保している。

安定した事業基盤と堅実な財務運営を強みに、業界環境の変化と競争激化に対応しながら事業の持続的な成長と中長期的な企業価値の向上を目指す経営姿勢を堅持している。今後の経営戦略の遂行状況と事業展開の成果が中長期的な企業の成長軌道と持続可能な価値創造を決定づけていく。
ai_summary.text_en: Sansan is a B2B SaaS company that develops the Sansan business card management service and the Bill One invoice management service. Sales reached  43.2 billion, achieving high year-on-year growth of approximately 30%. Operating income was  2.8 billion, achieving profitability, but net income was  400 million, with a heavy burden of non-operating expenses. The equity ratio is approximately 30%, which is standard for a growth company. Operating CF is extremely strong at  9.7 billion, with FCF positive  7.1 billion. A score of 78 reflects an evaluation of the high growth and stable CF of the SaaS business.  Earnings per share (EPS) is  3.4, book value per share (BPS) is  118.3, and return on equity (ROE) is 2.6%. Internal reserves are being accumulated through the stabilization of business earnings and improved management efficiency, securing investment capacity for future growth.  The company maintains a management policy that aims for sustainable business growth and the enhancement of corporate value in the medium to long term, while responding to changes in the industry environment and intensifying competition, leveraging its stable business base and sound financial management. The execution of future management strategies and the results of business development will determine the company's medium- to long-term growth trajectory and sustainable value creation.
